assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: wide environmental background illustration for a Portuguese Avatar fan atlas. Beautiful 16:9 landscape, no characters, no lettering, no logos. Hand-painted 2D animation background with fine clean linework, gouache texture, soft atmospheric depth and carefully composed foreground framing. Bright cream daylight, pastel coral, sage mint, lavender shadows, warm yellow accents. Sophisticated cinematic anime environment with layered painted detail; inspired by the adventurous environments of Avatar and the colorful new Seven Havens direction. This is an original decorative landscape, not an official scene. Leave the middle upper third calm enough for a short heading. A luminous polar harbor beside a turquoise sea, elegant curved snow-and-ice architecture, pale blue glacier cliffs, delicate bridges, tiny coral sailboats in the distance, peach sunrise reflections, snow-covered foreground rocks. Broad view across a sheltered bay. No tropical vegetation.
